lede: The biggest item this week is Wednesday's SMART board meeting, where two resolutions go to a vote: one restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee and another assigning professional responsibilities tied to the $5.2M/year gondola tax project voters approved under 3A — real structural decisions about how that money gets managed. Also worth your attention: San Miguel County Planning Commission meets Thursday to work through subdivision mechanics and take up an energy code update that would change building standards for new construction countywide. Mushroom Fest runs through the weekend, and school orientation kicks off Monday for incoming Telluride Middle-High students.

notable.stake: Board votes on resolutions restructuring gondola committee and $5.2M tax project oversight.
County energy code update could change building standards for all new construction.
HARC decides whether to approve an unpermitted structure in the Historic Landmark District.
Preliminary large-scale review of Shandoka Lot redevelopment — major new construction in town.
